req.title: Register requires password
req.statement: The system shall render the register form with an error message when POST /auth/register omits the password.

doc.reasoning: R-FLASKR-005 requires that POST /auth/register with a missing password field renders the register form with the exact error message 'Password is required.' and returns an HTTP 2xx status. Tests cover: (1) positive case — username provided but password omitted triggers the exact error string; (2) negative case — both username and password provided succeeds (no error, redirect); (3) boundary case — empty-string password (equivalent to omitted) triggers the same error; (4) decision-table case — username also missing takes a different error path, confirming the password check is guarded by the username check; (5) state-transition case — verifying the response stays on the register page (not redirected) when password is missing. Assertions use exact status codes, exact byte strings, and exact header values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_register_missing_password_shows_error
preconditions: Flask app created with TESTING=True and a fresh temp database
actions: POST /auth/register with username='NewUser' and no password field
expected: Response body contains exact text 'Password is required.'
trace: R-FLASKR-005: system shall render register form with error when password is omitted
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()
client = app.test_client()

def test_register_missing_password_shows_error():
    r = client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'NewUser'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert b'Password is required.' in r.data
    assert b'Username is required.' not in r.data

tests.name: test_register_missing_password_does_not_redirect
preconditions: Flask app created with TESTING=True and a fresh temp database
actions: POST /auth/register with username='StateUser' and password omitted
Check that the response is NOT a redirect
trace: R-FLASKR-005: state must remain on register page; a redirect would indicate incorrect success state transition
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()
client = app.test_client()

def test_register_missing_password_does_not_redirect():
    r = client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'StateUser'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.status_code != 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert '/auth/login' not in location
    assert b'Password is required.' in r.data
